The IRA has helped reduce our cost of investing in projects that support our commitment to reduce emissions and provide affordable, reliable, and clean energy for our communities.

We and our customers have benefited from the IRA’s provisions to extend tax benefits for renewable technologies, increase or restore higher rates for PTCs, claim PTCs for solar projects, expand qualified ITC facilities to include standalone energy storage, and allow companies to transfer tax credits generated from renewable projects.

Under the IRA transferability option, WEC Energy Group entered into agreements to sell the majority of the PTCs that we expect to generate in 2026 and a portion of the PTCs that we expect to generate in 2027 and 2028 to third parties.

Although significant regulatory guidance is expected on the tax provisions in the IRA, we currently believe the provisions on alternative minimum tax and stock repurchases will not have a material impact on us.
We will continue to monitor additional information as it becomes available.

We have received refunds of certain tariffs paid in connection with our capital projects and continue to pursue additional refunds, including requiring our contractors and vendors to seek refunds, as applicable, of tariffs paid under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act and other tariff provisions.
